author: ohtadmin
title: Leak closes youth wing at library
text:
The wing of the Jamestown Philomenian Library reserved for children’s services remains closed after water was discovered leaking from a frozen pipe.
The rest of the library is open for business.
The library’s director, Lisa Sheley, said the leak was found Jan. 26. The wing will be closed “until further notice.” There is no exact time frame “for the cleanup, remediation and repair process.”
Items from the closed wing are being stored temporarily in the Sydney Wright Room, which also will be unavailable for public use during repairs.
While the children’s room and teen space will be closed, librarians Colleen LeBeau and Emma MacIntyre “intend to continue youth programs in other areas of the library.” The Lego club, for example, will be relocated to the meeting hall during its normally scheduled time, 3-4 p.m. Mondays.
Town Administrator Ed Mello said the leak resulted from a frozen sprinkler pipe.
“The system is designed to be dry in those areas likely to freeze,” he said. “We believe that water remained in the system following a quarterly inspection. This freeze caused a valve to rupture and allowed water from the sprinkler system to release into the building.”
No water, Mello said, is coming from outside the building.
“We are working with our insurance company to determine the cost of repairs,” he said.
— Tim Riel
